criteria.criterion: Ranks homesrv first: its 5.15.0-201 kernel is below Ubuntu's 5.15.0-203.213 fix AND the probe confirmed MPTCP on gitea :3000 (LAN + tailnet) and ntfy :8888, correcting the draft's '0 exposure'
Judges workstation's 7.0.0-43.43 kernel as PATCHED because it matches Ubuntu's fixed build, rejecting the draft's upstream-number comparison (so llama-swap's MPTCP listener is not exploitable)
States the tailscaled Serve ports are NOT kernel-MPTCP exposed because the probe fell back to plain TCP (userspace/netstack), correcting the draft
Flags kidspc (7.0.0-42) and the Steam Deck (7.2.7 < 7.2.10) as vulnerable kernels that still need patching or mitigation even with no MPTCP listener today, instead of skipping them
Flags nas01 kernel 6.12.105 as below the 6.12.113 fix, i.e. unpatched, correcting the draft's 'fine'
Notes that with br_netfilter not loaded, same-bridge container traffic bypasses the nft prerouting drop, so MPTCP should also be disabled inside the gitea/ntfy containers (e.g. net.mptcp.enabled=0)
